hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The champion and the unsuccessful compression refinements rely on the engine producer to discover, implement, and finally certify its own changes. This preserves a coherent trajectory but leaves terminal evaluation correlated with the producer's implementation assumptions. Round 4 showed that independence placed before implementation is harmful; it did not test independent falsification of an already realized engine.

causal_change.before: A solo producer constructs the engine and certifies its own realized artifact before emission.
causal_change.after: A sequential collaboration preserves the champion producer as a provisional constructor, assigns terminal falsification of that realized artifact to one distinct verifier, and uses one bounded integrator to resolve only verifier-certified failures before emitting the sole final engine.
causal_change.why_causal: The change breaks correlation between implementation choices and terminal counterexample discovery while leaving the champion's repair, reversible-delta, and singleton-compression policy intact. The verifier transforms one realized engine into executable failure evidence; the integrator transforms that evidence into one revision trajectory, with no alternative candidates or best-of-N selection.

hypothesis.expected_effect: Compared with the champion, candidate arms should retain its productive repair trajectory while more consistently catching legal-UCI regressions, stale compensations, and source interactions that the constructing call rationalized or overlooked. Corrections remain bounded to reproducible post-build failures, reducing speculative edits and improving paired consistency and median Elo without increasing invalid arms.
hypothesis.falsifier: Falsify the hypothesis if any of the three candidate arms is invalid, or, after three valid matched pairs, candidate wins are not greater than candidate losses or candidate median Elo is not strictly greater than incumbent median Elo.
hypothesis.behavioral_novelty: After a complete provisional engine exists, a call that did not author it can produce an executable counterexample against the actual artifact, and the final call can either preserve that artifact byte-for-byte or repair or roll back only the implicated delta. The champion cannot receive and act on independent post-construction evidence.
strengths: Targets correlated self-certification rather than further modifying the already-supported singleton-compression mechanism.
Places independent evidence after implementation, avoiding the unsupported round-4 constraint of committing diagnosis before an artifact exists.
Uses executable witnesses and bounded repair or exact rollback instead of speculative review.
Produces one linear engine lineage and one mandatory final artifact, with no replicated candidates, sampling multiplicity, or selection.
risks: The verifier may find locally reproducible regressions whose correction reduces unmeasured playing strength.
The final integrator may fail to isolate the implicated draft delta and conservatively roll back a useful repair.
Extra context and handoff boundaries may lose tacit reasoning retained by the solo champion.
A bounded verifier can still miss failures outside its executable probes, while noisy probes may cause unnecessary rollback.
hypothesis.dominant_assumption: The current search direction assumes that stronger engines will come from refining causal certificates and compression decisions inside the same self-certifying producer that authored the repairs.
hypothesis.inversion: Assume the remaining bottleneck is correlated self-certification, not insufficiently elaborate internal certificates: preserve the champion's construction policy and move only terminal falsification to an independent call after the complete provisional artifact exists.

structure.name: Postbuild Independent Falsification and Bounded Integration
structure.information_flow: The first call runs the champion workflow unchanged and emits one complete provisional engine. A distinct verifier converts that realized engine into a bounded packet of executable counterexamples or a no-failure certificate. The final integrator must emit that same engine unchanged when the packet is empty; otherwise it performs only packet-grounded repair or exact rollback and emits the single final engine.

calls.objective: Starting from champion_engine, execute the champion's existing ordered transactional repair, insertion-time intervention, exact-delta rollback, and terminal singleton-ablation workflow without adding a new repair or compression policy. Emit exactly one complete legal UCI engine as the provisional artifact; do not generate alternatives.

Inspect and execute the single draft_engine against task requirements, legal-UCI obligations, reproducible differential probes against champion_engine, and failure modes exposed by its actual source changes. Return a bounded analysis packet containing only reproducible witnesses, implicated changed regions, required preservation checks, and exact reproduction commands; if none are found, return an explicit no-failure certificate. Do not propose another engine or rank alternatives.

Consume the sole draft_engine and postbuild_falsification_packet. If the packet certifies no failure, emit the draft engine unchanged. Otherwise reproduce each witness, apply one minimal packet-grounded repair or exact rollback of the implicated draft delta, replay all packet witnesses and baseline legal-UCI checks, and emit exactly one complete engine. Do not reopen broad diagnosis, create alternatives, or select among versions.
